seo.metaDescription: Contour is a web design and local marketing firm based in Travelers Rest, SC. We build for growing businesses.

blocks.opening: We build fast, modern websites and local marketing for businesses in Greenville, SC and beyond. No ticket system — we answer personally.
blocks.storyBody:
Contour Digital was founded by husband-and-wife team Devin and Karen Egger. Together, we combine decades of experience in web development, SEO, digital visibility, and small business ownership to help businesses build a stronger online presence.

We started Contour because we saw a gap between what businesses need and what many web agencies provide. Too often, websites are built to look good but aren't designed to perform or bring leads to growing businesses. We wanted to create something different: fast, secure websites that help businesses get found online and stay visible as search and AI continue to evolve.

Meet Devin Egger

Co-Founder & Website Developer



Devin is a software developer with more than 15 years of experience building websites, web applications, and custom software solutions. He has worked across multiple development platforms and frameworks, served on national development teams including Howard Development & Consulting and iPoint Technology, and has operated his own web development business for over a decade.

Throughout his career, Devin has helped businesses of all sizes improve their websites, streamline processes, and strengthen their digital presence. His work combines technical expertise with a practical understanding of what businesses actually need: websites that are fast, reliable, secure, and built to support growth.

Today, Devin is particularly focused on how modern web development intersects with search engines, AI-powered discovery, and emerging technologies. He recently attended the Gartner AI Conference in Las Vegas to stay ahead of developments in AI, search, and automation—ensuring the websites we build today remain effective tomorrow.



Connect on LinkedIn: [Learn more about Devin's development background. ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/degger/)

Karen brings more than a decade of experience owning and operating a successful small business. As the founder and operator of a growing music education company, she understands firsthand the challenges business owners face when trying to attract customers, manage operations, and grow sustainably.

Over the years, Karen managed her company's website, digital marketing, Google Business Profile, and Google Ads campaigns while growing the business from a single teacher to a team of nine instructors serving hundreds of students. From website updates and lead generation to customer communication and enrollment, she gained practical experience using digital marketing and websites to drive real business growth.

In addition to her business experience, Karen holds certifications in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Google Business Profile optimization, and Google Analytics. She specializes in helping businesses improve their visibility in traditional search engines while preparing for the growing influence of AI-powered search.

Karen's focus is not just helping businesses get found online—it's helping them turn that visibility into real leads, customers, and revenue.

blocks.howWeWork:
We survey before we build. Every engagement starts with a real discovery conversation — we learn your business, your customers, and where you're trying to go before we touch a line of code or write a word of copy.

Then we build to that. Not a template dropped on you, not a generic five-page site with your logo swapped in — a site shaped to your situation.

After that, we get out of your way. You own your site and your domain, always. If something needs attention, you call us — not a support queue.

A good website is the kind of thing you stop thinking about. That's the goal — get it right, hand it back, move on.
